x-notifications.name: Preflight
x-notifications.description: Startup-only pinned-child validation; API and absolute directory validation follow field extraction and unknown-field rejection.

x-notifications.name: PreflightFailed
x-notifications.description: Operation error; one-shot child still completes successfully.

x-notifications.name: MaintenanceFinished
x-notifications.description: Operation Result<(),String>; success is Ok:null and failure Err:string.

x-notifications.name: Stopping
x-notifications.description: Stop reached dispatcher; cleanup is not complete.

x-notifications.name: Released
x-notifications.description: Monotonic resource release, independent of terminal lifetime.

x-notifications.name: Adopted
x-notifications.description: Ownership acknowledgement, never admission credit. Wire u64 includes zero; pending-transfer validation retains its original separate checks.

x-notifications.name: SupervisorStart
x-notifications.description: Bootstrap with complete generated Source/Handoff metadata. API is checked before Source decoding; listener descriptor allocation precedes handoff batching. Current producers emit every nullable field; the fieldwise legacy receiver accepts absent legacy_listener. Unknown outer fields reject before handoff validation, and overlap/count/descriptor checks retain their original order. Ownership adoption occurs only when the full handoff is complete.

x-notifications.name: Maintenance
x-notifications.description: One-shot maintenance operation with stdout/stderr descriptor capabilities. Operation decoding precedes descriptor extraction, stdout is adopted before stderr decoding, unknown fields precede API/output-writability validation. No multipart maintenance request.

x-notifications.name: Leases
x-notifications.description: Continuation of one already pending handoff. Fields decode and unknown keys reject before pending-state lookup. Transfer must match; leases must be nonempty; count, more and cumulative bytes/descriptor references are checked before final adoption. No allocation is based on declared count. Either transfer-sending peer can emit these frames.
x-notifications.connection-state: after a handoff header with more=true, until declared count is satisfied

x-notifications.name: Command.Start
x-notifications.description: Give an accepted member its handoff. Root handoff extraction and unknown-field rejection precede nested decoding; overlap/count/descriptor checks and final adoption are unchanged.

x-notifications.name: Event.Exported
x-notifications.description: Return a member handoff or an error. Decode member then standard Result<Value,String>, reject unknown root fields, and only then decode an Ok handoff. Err has no descriptor ownership or adoption.
x-notifications.connection-state: operational response to Command.Export on an established supervisor connection

x-notifications.name: Event.Manifest
x-notifications.description: Publish a manifest lease and opaque catalogue JSON string. Decode sequence/path/root/catalogue before owner capability, then transfer and unknown fields; reject zero transfer before lease adoption. Root/owner consistency and lock identity remain the original ManifestLease validation. Even unrooted manifests require typed adoption.
x-notifications.connection-state: existing operational result or preflight manifest result

x-notifications.name: Command.Spawn
x-notifications.description: Spawn metadata with generated kind and stdio. Decode id/kind/argv/cwd/env before stdio capabilities; consume stdio before rejecting unknown root fields. No adoption token is introduced.

x-notifications.name: Command.Signal
x-notifications.description: Forward a structural i32 signal to a process id; existing operation policy and process lookup remain unchanged.

x-notifications.name: Command.CancelProcess
x-notifications.description: With everything=false, cancel the exec process group below its keeper. With everything=true, cancel every process below that exec keeper, including the original group and processes that left it.

x-notifications.name: Command.KillAll
x-notifications.description: End all processes started by Spawn; no fields and no change to existing cancellation barriers.

x-notifications.name: Event.Spawned
x-notifications.description: Process id and native i32 pid metadata; no new process-policy validation.

x-notifications.name: Event.SpawnFailed
x-notifications.description: Process spawn failure with required nullable native i32 code and original message string.

x-notifications.name: Event.Exited
x-notifications.description: Process exit metadata with required nullable code/signal; preserve both original Option<i32> fields without new exclusivity checks.

x-notifications.name: Command.Attach
x-notifications.description: Duplicate and transfer one frontend stream descriptor after terminal metadata and before dimensions. Preserve terminal/descriptor/rows/cols extraction order and full u16 wire ranges; no adoption.

x-notifications.name: Command.Detach
x-notifications.description: Detach the specified runtime terminal; preserve existing policy and terminal lookup.

x-notifications.name: Command.Resize
x-notifications.description: Carry a terminal identity and full native u16 dimensions; semantic size validation remains with existing terminal operations.

x-notifications.name: Command.TerminalCall
x-notifications.description: Carry the original externally tagged terminal Call without early semantic validation. Request and process-terminal IDs retain u64 wire range.

x-notifications.name: Command.TerminalCancel
x-notifications.description: Cancel an outstanding terminal request by its original u64 request ID.

x-notifications.name: Event.Terminal
x-notifications.description: Terminal snapshot with six original status flags and a required nullable error string. Status fields remain structurally open and all six flags are required.

x-notifications.name: Event.TerminalResult
x-notifications.description: Terminal result remains an opaque String encoding standard Result<Value,String>. Parse request then inner JSON before unknown-root rejection; arbitrary inner JSON is descriptor-free data.

x-notifications.name: Command.Cancel
x-notifications.description: Cancel queued or running work by its approval or serial id: Preview/Refresh use approval, while Run/Diff use serial. Existing cancellation policy stays unchanged.

x-notifications.name: Command.Preview
x-notifications.description: Request package preview by approval id and package string. No package-name policy is added at the wire boundary.

x-notifications.name: Command.Decide
x-notifications.description: Deliver the original approval Request, decision boolean and required nullable output path, preserving request/approved/output extraction order.

x-notifications.name: Event.Preview
x-notifications.description: Private preview result uses output_path, including null, plus in_store/download/build_required; public catalog Preview still skips output_path. The original private json! non-UTF8 path panic boundary is retained.

x-notifications.name: Event.Progress
x-notifications.description: Report original request and state strings without introducing new state validation.

x-notifications.name: Event.Granted
x-notifications.description: Deliver original Reply (null id and omitted absent message) plus required nullable detail and output path, preserving reply/detail/output extraction order.

x-notifications.name: Command.Refresh
x-notifications.description: Request dev-shell refresh by approval with original Changes metadata; semantic input/lock handling stays at existing operation sites.

x-notifications.name: Command.Run
x-notifications.description: Request flake work by serial and app string without new app-name validation at the wire boundary.

x-notifications.name: Command.Diff
x-notifications.description: Request dev-shell diff by serial with original Changes metadata and unchanged policy.

x-notifications.name: Event.Refresh
x-notifications.description: Refresh result remains opaque String JSON for Result<(Value,String),String>. Decode approval before inner parsing and finish root afterward.

x-notifications.name: Event.Call
x-notifications.description: Serial result remains opaque String JSON for Result<Value,String>; arbitrary JSON and descriptor-looking keys remain data.

x-notifications.name: Event.DevShell
x-notifications.description: Current summary remains opaque String JSON with original identity/u32 generation/arbitrary lock. Parse at the original summary extraction point before root finish.

x-notifications.name: Command.PrepareHostJob
x-notifications.description: Prepare the host directory shown for a host command, preserving request/cwd field extraction and native path serialization; host policy stays unchanged.

x-notifications.name: Command.RunHostJob
x-notifications.description: Run approved host work with original request/argv/environment pairs/required nullable u64 timeout metadata; no argument, environment-name or timeout policy is added at the wire boundary.

x-notifications.name: Command.CancelHostJob
x-notifications.description: Cancel host work identified by the original request string using existing cancellation policy.

x-notifications.name: Event.HostJobPrepared
x-notifications.description: Report plain Result<PathBuf,String> for the host directory. Preserve request before result parsing and native path serialization errors.

x-notifications.name: Event.HostJobFailed
x-notifications.description: Report why an approved host command could not start, with original request and error strings.

x-notifications.name: Event.HostJobFinished
x-notifications.description: Report plain Result<HostOutcome,String> when the host supervisor exits. Preserve independent outcome flags and nullable exit/signal/spawn-error metadata, with no new exclusivity policy.

x-notifications.name: Command.ScopeFailed
x-notifications.description: Preserve the scope-wide exit outcome after unexpected engine death. Present empty object params are required.

x-notifications.name: Command.Export
x-notifications.description: Export the published generation and fresh resource lease chain for member without waiting for Nix work, answered by Event.Exported.

x-notifications.name: Command.Stop
x-notifications.description: Begin cancellation and teardown with present empty object params; existing teardown barriers and lifecycle control notifications Stopping/Released stay unchanged.

x-notifications.name: Event.ScopeFailed
x-notifications.description: Report the named scope failure using the original event string; this payload is distinct from the empty ScopeFailed command.

x-notifications.name: Event.ScopeNeeded
x-notifications.description: Request private scope membership by name without blocking the event pump. The daemon uses its captured executable pin.

x-notifications.name: Event.Mode
x-notifications.description: Announce whether the agent runs without a terminal before slow launch work.

x-notifications.name: Event.Stopped
x-notifications.description: Report sandbox, host-job and resource cleanup complete, independently of retained terminal output. exit_code is required and nullable, with full native i32 range.

x-notifications.name: Event.Failed
x-notifications.description: Report launch/runtime failure as the original error string.

x-notifications.name: Event.InitLost
x-notifications.description: Report the sandbox init channel closed: no process can start and none reports further. Present empty object params are required.

x-notifications.name: Event.PayloadExited
x-notifications.description: Report the main payload exited; the daemon decides the session outcome. Present empty object params are required.

x-notifications.name: Command.ScopeMembership
x-notifications.description: Deliver resolved private scope membership as standard Result<descriptor,String>. Parse the result and consume its referenced capability before unknown-root rejection; original descriptor ownership, cleanup and scope authority remain unchanged. No adoption token or continuation is introduced.

x-transport.decoding: Original Params take/finish order; raw envelope and owned descriptors remain handwritten.

Setup.reason: Scope Setup payload contract remains separate; only the existing first-frame method identity is bound here.

x-phases.description: Classify the raw first method before general decoding or runtime startup. Missing, non-string or unknown methods retain the existing refusal; Setup retains its independent descriptor refusal.

x-phases.name: maintenance-first
x-phases.description: Reject any other raw first method and dispose descriptors before logical decode, cancellation setup or cleanup operations.

x-phases.name: preflight-adopted
x-phases.description: After sending a rooted or unrooted manifest requiring adoption, only scalar Adopted reaches the decoder. Wrong-direction multipart data is dropped before pending receive state.

x-phases.name: manifest-result
x-phases.description: Only one single-frame manifest or operation failure may reach one-shot result decoding. Preserve raw descriptor disposal on wrong-direction rejection and all later result/ACK/EOF/reap validation.

x-phases.name: maintenance-result
x-phases.description: Only the single-frame maintenance result reaches logical decoding. Existing fixed post-result deadline, EOF and successful reap requirements remain unchanged.
